content.title: New York Times: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — The New York Times Co. (NYT) on Wednesday reported net income of $81.6 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the New York-based company said it had net income of 50 cents. Earnings, adjusted for one-time gains and costs, were 59 cents per share.
